sh -c 'if [ -z "$SHELL" ] || [ ! -x "$SHELL" ]; then echo "Codex remote SSH requires SHELL to point to an executable login shell" >&2; exit 127; fi; CODEX_REMOTE_PAYLOAD="$1"; export CODEX_REMOTE_PAYLOAD; case "${SHELL##*/}" in csh|tcsh) exec "$SHELL" -i -c '\''set loginsh=1; if ( -r /etc/csh.login ) source /etc/csh.login; if ( -r ~/.login ) source ~/.login; exec /bin/sh -c "$CODEX_REMOTE_PAYLOAD"'\'' ;; nu) exec "$SHELL" -l -i -c '\''exec /bin/sh -c $env.CODEX_REMOTE_PAYLOAD'\'' ;; fish|xonsh) exec "$SHELL" -l -i -c '\''exec /bin/sh -c "$CODEX_REMOTE_PAYLOAD"'\'' ;; *) exec "$SHELL" -l -i -c '\''CODEX_HOME="${CODEX_HOME:-$HOME/.codex}"; export CODEX_HOME; exec /bin/sh -c "$CODEX_REMOTE_PAYLOAD"'\'' ;; esac' sh 'ls -la /'
